sample_essay:
The express delivery service industry in China has witnessed remarkable development in recent years. To begin with, technological advancements have been a major driving force. With the widespread use of the Internet and mobile apps, customers can easily place orders and track their packages in real-time. For example, platforms like Cainiao and JD Logistics offer convenient interfaces for users to manage their deliveries.

In addition, the industry's expansion has had a profound impact on people's lives. It has greatly facilitated online shopping. Consumers can now purchase a wide variety of products from all over the country or even the world, and have them delivered to their doorstep. Moreover, it has created numerous job opportunities, from couriers to warehouse workers, contributing to economic growth.

In conclusion, the express delivery service industry in China has not only grown rapidly due to technological progress but also brought about positive changes in people's daily lives and the economy.
